body.message:
As per your request, please find the 1-month rates for Seaside Hills Residences - 1 bedroom without view below:

October: AED 8,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis only (30 nights per month).

To confirm and secure a 3-month or 6-month booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you.
